description: This header file declares the CredentialSource interface and functions to create CredentialSource objects, used for handling Google Cloud authentication credentials within the Android Cuttlefish project's web component.

classes.name: CredentialSource
classes.description: An abstract class representing a credential source that can provide credentials as strings.

methods.name: Credential
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the credential as a string.

methods.name: GetCredentialSource
methods.description: Function to create a credential source based on provided parameters such as OAuth file paths and GCE metadata flag.

methods.name: CreateRefreshTokenCredentialSource
methods.description: Function to create a credential source using OAuth refresh token credentials.

calls: GetCredentialSource(http_client, credential_source, oauth_filepath, use_gce_metadata, credential_filepath, service_account_filepath)
